name: Entity Hierarchy Widgets
description: Provides widgets to display and manage hierarchical structures provided by the Entity Hierarchy module.
project_description: Companion module for Entity Hierarchy (entity_reference_hierarchy) that adds editorial and display UI for hierarchies. It provides three things: a drag-and-drop table form (per entity, at {canonical}/hierarchy) to reorder and re-parent the whole tree at once rather than only direct children; an 'entity_hierarchy_nested' entity-reference selection plugin that presents referenceable entities as an indented tree, like core's hierarchical taxonomy term select; and an 'Entity Hierarchy Menu' block that renders the current entity's hierarchy as a nested link list. Depends on Entity Hierarchy 5.x.
